run_xnli_training_evaluation: run XNLI training and evaluation across all 15 languages with an embedder and params
load_xnli_cross_lingual_data: load XNLI cross-lingual classification data for train, valid, and test splits across languages
train_xnli_model: train the XNLI model by finetuning the embedder and projection layer on English training data
eval_xnli_accuracy: evaluate XNLI model accuracy on validation and test sets for all supported languages
get_xnli_data_iterator: get a monolingual data iterator for a specific split and language with shuffling and size grouping
